notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.07.25.4:

- Certificate Analysis: add manual entry option for expiry dates. When customer .cer files are unavailable, operator can now manually enter certificate name and expiry date. Manual entries display alongside imported certificates in the comparison table with automatic status detection (VALID/EXPIRING_SOON/EXPIRED).
- Recommendations: rename 'Version Upgrade' quick-add category to 'Hotfix / Patch' to better reflect critical updates and patches.
- Agent Compatibility: dynamically hidden when no agent version entries (Web Endpoint Agent, DLP Endpoint Agent, Classification Agent) exist in Version & EoS Summary, even if product scope includes DLP/Web/DSPM/Classification. Tombstoned (removed) agent entries no longer prevent the page from hiding.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
